Duties & Responsibilities Technology & AI Strategy Develop and govern the account’s long-term technology and AI strategy, ensuring alignment with the Master Service Agreement (MSA) and client business objectives. Utilize machine learning models to forecast KPI performance, identify potential risks, and recommend proactive interventions. Implement AI-driven dashboards and real-time reporting that provide the account team with actionable intelligence to optimize their performance. Lead performance discussions at quarterly business reviews, presenting not only results but also data-driven root cause analyses and forward-looking strategic recommendations. Advanced Analytics & Business Intelligence Lead all account business intelligence and data science activities. Collaborate with stakeholders to design, deliver, and maintain sophisticated BI reports and dashboards that visualize complex data and AI-driven insights. Transform raw data into actionable strategic insights using advanced analytical techniques and machine learning models. Oversee the fulfillment of all contractual reporting obligations, enhancing them with automated and intelligent reporting where possible. AI-Ready Data Governance Establish and maintain a robust data pipeline and governance framework specifically designed to support AI and machine learning initiatives. Continuously monitor and report on the account’s data quality and integrity, understanding its direct impact on the efficacy of predictive models. Experience in technology strategy, client advisory, AI project management, and business process optimization. Advanced skills in data analytics, business intelligence, and a strong conceptual understanding of machine learning and AI principles. Experience in the commercial property or facilities management sector is desirable but not essential. Sound like you? To apply you need to be… Experienced in managing complex technology projects or portfolios, ideally in a regional or global context. Used to working with stakeholders with different experience levels, from entry-level roles to senior leadership, and can work and communicate effectively across organizational lines. Able to handle multiple strategic initiatives across a range of disciplines simultaneously. Possess deep technological curiosity and a proven ability to quickly master new platforms, with a strong foundational understanding of AI/ML concepts. An analytical and strategic thinker, able to simplify complex issues and solve problems creatively. Able to manage competing priorities, be resilient, and resolve conflict quickly to achieve desired results. Trustworthy, with the ability to establish and maintain a high level of customer confidence in the technology, data, and analytics space.
